To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) multilingual image description is a challenging task and (b) our neural models substantially improve upon state of the art for this task.

we present multilingual image description and introduce a new dataset of images paired to sentences in English and German, and we present neural models that substantially improve upon existing models for this task.

multilingual image description can be achieved with models that combine visual features from object recognition and multimodal features from monolingual image captioning models, and that these models substantially improve over the state-of-the-art for monolingual image captions in terms of both fluency and content.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing methods for generating descriptions of images in multiple languages.
two main questions: How to generate image descriptions in multiple languages, and how to use the image to improve machine translation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the paper presents the first attempt at multilingual image description.
our model is able to generate multilingual descriptions for images in English and German.
our multilingual image description model performs well on the dataset and is a significant improvement over previous work.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel model for multilingual image description and we show that our models are capable of generating descriptions of the same image in different languages.
we are able to improve on the state-of-the-art in image description by leveraging the additional information provided by a second language.
we have shown that it is possible to generate image descriptions in multiple languages and that the image can play an important role in disambiguation of the language.
The main takeaway from our work is that

multilingual image description is a useful testbed for evaluating the ability of image description models to disambiguate language, and that the task can be solved by combining existing monolingual models with visual features.
the image can play a role in improving machine translation, even when it is not directly used to train the model.
multilingual image description is an interesting and challenging problem, and that it is a promising area for future research.
